SUBSTITUTE NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment #22844-T}
3059 North Leavitt Street
From RS-3 to RM-5

The Property

The subject property is improved with a 2-story, multi-unit residential building containing 4 legal conforming
units, and 2 non-conforming units. The surrounding area is comprised of RS-3, RS-3.5, RT-4, and RM-S zoning
districts. The area is improved with buildings of various heights ranging from | to 4 stories that contain residential
and commercial uses. The property is also a Transit Served Location per the Transit Oriented Provisions of the
Chicago Zoning Ordinance (Section 17-10-0102-B (1)) as it is within 705 feet of the Belmont Avenue Bus Line
Corridor Roadway Segment.

The Project
The subject property is improved with a 2-story, multi-unit residential building containing 4 legal conforming

units, and 2 non-conforming units. The Applicant proposes to rezone the property to retain the 4 legal conforming
units and make the 2 non-conforming units conforming for a total of 6 conforming units. 2 automobile parking
spaces and 6 bicycle parking spaces are proposed. The zoning height of the building will remain unchanged at
32.5 feet. No other changes are proposed, To allow the proposed development, the Applicant seeks a zoning
change for the subject property from an RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District to a RM-S
Residential Multi-Unit District. The Applicant is filing a Type 1 rezoning application and seeks all relief necessary
and as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the proposed project, including: The Applicant seeks all relief
necessary and as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the proposed project, including: 1) a variation under
section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the south side setback from 2.5 feet to 1.92 feet; 2) a variation under section 17-
13-1101-B to reduce the front yard setback from 14.82 feet to .45 feet; and 3) a variation under 17-13-1101-A and
17-13-1003-K to reduce the required rear yard open space from 216 square feet to 0 square feet.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 3,086.50 sq. ft.

Floor Area: 3,128.23 sq. ft.

FAR: 2.0

Residential Dwelling Units; 6

MLA Density: 514.50 sq. ft.

Height: 32.50 ft.

Automobile Parking: 2

Bicycle Parking: 6

Setbacks: Front (N. Leavitt St.) 0.45”
Side (North) 0.40”
Side (South) 1.92°

Rear (Alley) 48.31"
